title: AI News Anchor
tagline: Reads the script, delivers it like a person would.

meta.title: AI News Anchor | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: Reads the script, delivers it like a person would.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Staffing live anchors around the clock is expensive, and fully automated delivery usually reads flat — it struggles to hold attention.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: The anchor mimics human delivery: facial expression and gesture shift with the tone of the script instead of reading everything in the same register.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: 24/7 broadcast capability with a presenter that stays consistent and doesn't fatigue.
